function getWordNumber pChunkString
	local tChunkString
	
	if pChunkString is empty then
		 put mouseChunk() into tChunkString
	else
		 put pChunkString into tChunkString
	end if
	
	-- Use LiveCode's chunk parsing - get the word number directly
	if "word" is in tChunkString then
		 -- Parse: "char X to Y of word N of field Z" -> get the N
		 set itemDelimiter to " "
		 repeat with i = 1 to the number of items in tChunkString
			 if item i of tChunkString is "word" then
				 return item (i + 1) of tChunkString as integer
			 end if
		 end repeat
	end if
	
	return 0
end getWordNumber
